So our total degrees of freedom is:

$$
  \begin{split}
    df & = \text{(number of observations) - (number of constraints)} \\
    \ 
       & = (r \times c) - (c + (r - 1))                              \\
    \ 
       & = rc - c - r + 1                                            \\
    \  & = (r - 1)(c - 1)
  \end{split}
$$
